key_insight: OCEL1 was the only transcript consistently prioritized across two expression cohorts and showed a positive conditional cis-MR association with heel bone mineral density.
clinical_relevance: This study suggests OCEL1 may be a candidate biomarker or biology target for low BMD research, but it is not ready for clinical use.
method: Screened differential expression signals from GSE56815 and restricted them to a 25-term MSigDB thematic set.
Used linear SVM, LASSO, and XGBoost to rank shared transcript features across GSE56815 and GSE2208.
Tested OCEL1 in a four-exposure locus-aware cis-MR model using eQTLGen cis-eQTLs, heel eBMD GWAS data, and UKBB LD.
evidence_signal: Across 107 shared features, the three machine-learning methods converged on CPNE1, EZR, and OCEL1, and only OCEL1 showed concordant direction in both cohorts with a positive cis-MR estimate (beta=0.010293, P=0.01220).
watch_item: The findings rely on nominal transcriptomic signals and a model-based genetic inference, so replication and functional validation are needed before interpretation as causal.
paper_title: Transcriptomic and Machine-Learning Prioritization of OCEL1 in Low Bone Mineral Density With Multivariable cis-MR
